characters.name: Ahmad
characters.description: host; dark curly hair, short beard, olive-green overshirt over a cream T-shirt, dark trousers, wristwatch

characters.name: Sami
characters.description: guest; dark curly hair, round glasses, red hoodie, dark grey backpack

characters.name: Haru
characters.description: Ahmad's dog; large German-shepherd-type dog, tan and black coat, brown collar with a gold tag (no lines)

characters.name: Lulu
characters.description: Ahmad's wife's cat; grey tabby with green eyes and an orange collar with a bell (no lines)

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.ar: أهلا وسهلا يا سامي! تفضل، بيتي بيتك.
lines.translit: ahlan w-sahlan yā Sāmi! tfaḍḍal, bētī bētak.
lines.en: Welcome, Sami! Come in—my house is your house.

flags.note: Bubble has أهلا وسهلا … تفضل (no tanwīn, no shadda); dialogue has أهلًا وسهلًا … تفضّل.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.en: Thank you. Your house is really nice.

flags.note: Bubble has يسلمو. (no final alif, full stop); dialogue has يسلموا، (alif, comma).

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.ar: يسلم ذوقك. هاي غرفة القعدة. تفضّل.
lines.translit: yislam zōʾak. hāy ghurfet il-ʾaʿde. tfaḍḍal.
lines.en: That’s very kind of you. This is the living room. Go ahead.

flags.note: Extra line in the comic (Sami: شكراً.) not in the printed dialogue; translit and English supplied editorially, not printed.

panels.note: Dialogue narration "Sami sits down on the couch and notices a family picture." (line 3) is not drawn as a caption.

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.en: Who are these people in the picture?

flags.note: Bubble has الناس اللي بالصورة (no shaddas); dialogue has النّاس اللّي بالصّورة.

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.ar: هاي عيلتي. هاد أبوي، وهاي امي، وهاد أخوي.  بس هم مش هون اليوم.
lines.translit: hāy ʿēltī. hād abūy, w-hāy immī, w-hād akhūy. bass humme mish hōn il-yōm.
lines.en: This is my family. This is my father, this is my mother, and this is my brother. But they’re not here today.

flags.note: Bubble has امي, بس, هم; dialogue has إمّي, بسّ, همّ. Bubble also has a double space after أخوي. (Canva source).

panels.note: Dialogue narration "After showing Sami the picture, Ahmad gets up from the couch." (line 6) is not drawn as a caption.

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.en: I need a few things from my room.

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.ar: وهادا كلبي هارو، وهديك بسّة مرتي، لولو.
lines.translit: w-hāda kalbī Hāru, w-hadīk bisset martī, Lūlu.
lines.en: This is my dog, Haru, and that’s my wife’s cat, Lulu.

panels.note: Haru and Lulu appear. Dialogue narration (line 9: dog licks Sami's hand, cat strolls past) is not drawn as a caption; the licking is not depicted.

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.ar: شكلها غريبة شوي… بس هي كتير لطيفة.
lines.translit: shiklha gharībe shwayy… bass hiyye ktīr laṭīfe.
lines.en: She looks a little funny… but she’s really sweet.

flags.note: Bubble has شوي and بس; dialogue has شويّ and بسّ.

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.ar: ما شاء الله! كلبك كبير كتير!
lines.translit: mā shāʾ Allāh! kalbak kbīr ktīr!
lines.en: Wow! Your dog is really big!

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.en: Yeah, he’s big… but he’s very calm.

flags.note: Bubble has آه كبير… بس (no comma, no shadda); dialogue has آه، كبير… بسّ.

panels.note: Dialogue narration "They reach Ahmad's room…" (line 14) is not drawn as a caption.

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

flags.note: Bubble has ثواني بس… (no shadda, ellipsis); dialogue has ثواني بسّ. (shadda, full stop).

imageSource.note: Working copy with every bubble’s text centred and sized; the original design DAHaz00vw2w is unchanged.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.en: I need my cell phone, my keys, and a little money.

flags.note: Bubble has بدي جوالي ومفاتيحي وشوية مصاري. (no shaddas, no commas, و before مفاتيحي); dialogue has بدّي جوّالي، مفاتيحي، وشويّة مصاري.

panels.note: Dialogue narration "Ahmad returns with everything he needs." (line 18) is not drawn as a caption; panel shows Ahmad picking up phone, keys and money.
